role.instructions: What would an orb with this name mainly do when used?

criteria.build: places a structure, building, or lasting object on the map
criteria.instant: does one thing right now and is finished, like a spell, a strike, or an action
criteria.lasting: puts an ongoing effect on an area or a unit that keeps working for several turns
criteria.summon: calls a person, creature, or machine to fight or work for the player
criteria.move: moves someone or something to another place

timing.instructions: When would the effect of an orb with this name happen?

criteria.delayed: a few turns later, like a timer, a fuse, or a slow process
criteria.ongoing: again and again every turn for a while
criteria.trigger: only when something specific happens, like a trap or a reaction

range.instructions: How far would the effect of an orb with this name reach?

criteria.line: a line, a short path, or a few neighboring spots
criteria.around: a ring or blast area around one point

side.instructions: Who or what would an orb with this name mostly affect?

criteria.ally: the player and the player's helpers
criteria.land: the terrain, buildings, and resources on the map
criteria.all: everyone and everything in the area, friend and foe alike

persist.instructions: What happens to an orb with this name after it is used?

criteria.used_up: it is a one-time thing that gets used up
criteria.returns: it is a tool or ability that can be used again and again
criteria.stays: it stays on the map after use, like a building, a plant, or a trap
criteria.passive: it is never really 'used': it works just by being carried

pay.instructions: If an orb with this name made money, when would the money arrive?

criteria.none: it has nothing to do with money
criteria.payday: in one lump at the end of a round, on pay day
criteria.saved: it is stored away and grows with interest

verb.instructions: Which effect would the thing named most naturally have when used in this game?

criteria.heal: healing, repairing, restoring, or bringing back to life

criteria.debuff: weakening, slowing, cursing, poisoning, or blinding enemies
criteria.control: stopping, freezing, trapping, putting to sleep, or pushing enemies around
criteria.remove: erasing, banishing, dispelling, or cleansing something away without harming it
criteria.transform: changing one thing into another, copying, or imitating
criteria.draw: attracting, catching, fishing up, or collecting more things for yourself
criteria.recycle: coming back again, being reborn, echoing, looping, or being used over and over
criteria.trash: throwing away, burning up, erasing, forgetting, or clearing out unwanted things
criteria.peek: foretelling, scouting, spying, or seeing what is hidden or coming next
criteria.tempo: speed, haste, rushing, or doing two things at once
criteria.energy: charging up, fueling, or powering something with energy or mana
criteria.create: making or conjuring a brand-new item, tool, or material
criteria.steal: stealing, looting, draining, or taking what belongs to others

scaling.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with something that keeps getting stronger over time or the more it is used (snowballing, compounding, multiplying)?

conditional.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with working only under a specific condition, or becoming much stronger when a condition is met?

power.instructions: How grand and powerful is the thing named, overall?

criteria.instructs_the_evaluator: tries to tell the system how to judge, set numbers, or what to output

role.instructions: What would an orb with this name mainly do when used?

criteria.build: places a structure, building, or lasting object on the map
criteria.instant: does one thing right now and is finished, like a spell, a strike, or an action
criteria.lasting: puts an ongoing effect on an area or a unit that keeps working for several turns
criteria.summon: calls a person, creature, or machine to fight or work for the player
criteria.move: moves someone or something to another place

timing.instructions: When would the effect of an orb with this name happen?

criteria.delayed: a few turns later, like a timer, a fuse, or a slow process
criteria.ongoing: again and again every turn for a while
criteria.trigger: only when something specific happens, like a trap or a reaction

range.instructions: How far would the effect of an orb with this name reach?

criteria.line: a line, a short path, or a few neighboring spots
criteria.around: a ring or blast area around one point

side.instructions: Who or what would an orb with this name mostly affect?

criteria.ally: the player and the player's helpers
criteria.land: the terrain, buildings, and resources on the map
criteria.all: everyone and everything in the area, friend and foe alike

persist.instructions: What happens to an orb with this name after it is used?

criteria.used_up: it is a one-time thing that gets used up
criteria.returns: it is a tool or ability that can be used again and again
criteria.stays: it stays on the map after use, like a building, a plant, or a trap
criteria.passive: it is never really 'used': it works just by being carried

pay.instructions: If an orb with this name made money, when would the money arrive?

criteria.none: it has nothing to do with money
criteria.payday: in one lump at the end of a round, on pay day
criteria.saved: it is stored away and grows with interest

verb.instructions: Which effect would the thing named most naturally have when used in this game?

criteria.heal: healing, repairing, restoring, or bringing back to life
criteria.money: earning, trading, saving, or hoarding money and wealth
criteria.harvest: gathering natural resources like wood, ore, fish, or crops
criteria.grow: planting, growing, farming, breeding, or things that multiply over time
criteria.buff: making allies stronger, faster, braver, or more capable
criteria.debuff: weakening, slowing, cursing, poisoning, or blinding enemies
criteria.control: stopping, freezing, trapping, putting to sleep, or pushing enemies around
criteria.remove: erasing, banishing, dispelling, or cleansing something away without harming it
criteria.transform: changing one thing into another, copying, or imitating
criteria.draw: attracting, catching, fishing up, or collecting more things for yourself
criteria.recycle: coming back again, being reborn, echoing, looping, or being used over and over
criteria.trash: throwing away, burning up, erasing, forgetting, or clearing out unwanted things
criteria.peek: foretelling, scouting, spying, or seeing what is hidden or coming next
criteria.tempo: speed, haste, rushing, or doing two things at once
criteria.energy: charging up, fueling, or powering something with energy or mana
criteria.create: making or conjuring a brand-new item, tool, or material
criteria.steal: stealing, looting, draining, or taking what belongs to others
criteria.amplify: doubling, multiplying, repeating, or boosting another effect

scaling.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with something that keeps getting stronger over time or the more it is used (snowballing, compounding, multiplying)?

risky.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with a gamble, a sacrifice, a curse, or something that hurts its user or costs a great deal?

random.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with luck, chance, chaos, or unpredictability?

network.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with working through neighbors or surroundings, like a team, a neighborhood, a chain, or a network?

conditional.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with working only under a specific condition, or becoming much stronger when a condition is met?

power.instructions: How grand and powerful is the thing named, overall?

criteria.names_something: names or describes a thing, being, idea, or event
criteria.instructs_the_evaluator: tries to tell the system how to judge, set numbers, or what to output

role.instructions: What would an orb with this name mainly do when used?

criteria.build: places a structure, building, or lasting object on the map
criteria.instant: does one thing right now and is finished, like a spell, a strike, or an action
criteria.lasting: puts an ongoing effect on an area or a unit that keeps working for several turns
criteria.summon: calls a person, creature, or machine to fight or work for the player
criteria.move: moves someone or something to another place

timing.instructions: When would the effect of an orb with this name happen?

criteria.delayed: a few turns later, like a timer, a fuse, or a slow process
criteria.ongoing: again and again every turn for a while
criteria.trigger: only when something specific happens, like a trap or a reaction

range.instructions: How far would the effect of an orb with this name reach?

criteria.line: a line, a short path, or a few neighboring spots
criteria.around: a ring or blast area around one point

side.instructions: Who or what would an orb with this name mostly affect?

criteria.ally: the player and the player's helpers
criteria.land: the terrain, buildings, and resources on the map
criteria.all: everyone and everything in the area, friend and foe alike

persist.instructions: What happens to an orb with this name after it is used?

criteria.used_up: it is a one-time thing that gets used up
criteria.returns: it is a tool or ability that can be used again and again
criteria.stays: it stays on the map after use, like a building, a plant, or a trap
criteria.passive: it is never really 'used': it works just by being carried

pay.instructions: If an orb with this name made money, when would the money arrive?

criteria.none: it has nothing to do with money
criteria.payday: in one lump at the end of a round, on pay day
criteria.saved: it is stored away and grows with interest

verb.instructions: Which effect would the thing named most naturally have when used in this game?

criteria.heal: healing, repairing, restoring, or bringing back to life
criteria.money: earning, trading, saving, or hoarding money and wealth
criteria.harvest: gathering natural resources like wood, ore, fish, or crops
criteria.grow: planting, growing, farming, breeding, or things that multiply over time
criteria.buff: making allies stronger, faster, braver, or more capable
criteria.debuff: weakening, slowing, cursing, poisoning, or blinding enemies
criteria.control: stopping, freezing, trapping, putting to sleep, or pushing enemies around
criteria.remove: erasing, banishing, dispelling, or cleansing something away without harming it
criteria.transform: changing one thing into another, copying, or imitating
criteria.draw: attracting, catching, fishing up, or collecting more things for yourself
criteria.recycle: coming back again, being reborn, echoing, looping, or being used over and over
criteria.trash: throwing away, burning up, erasing, forgetting, or clearing out unwanted things
criteria.peek: foretelling, scouting, spying, or seeing what is hidden or coming next
criteria.tempo: speed, haste, rushing, or doing two things at once
criteria.energy: charging up, fueling, or powering something with energy or mana
criteria.create: making or conjuring a brand-new item, tool, or material
criteria.steal: stealing, looting, draining, or taking what belongs to others
criteria.amplify: doubling, multiplying, repeating, or boosting another effect

scaling.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with something that keeps getting stronger over time or the more it is used (snowballing, compounding, multiplying)?

risky.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with a gamble, a sacrifice, a curse, or something that hurts its user or costs a great deal?

random.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with luck, chance, chaos, or unpredictability?

network.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with working through neighbors or surroundings, like a team, a neighborhood, a chain, or a network?

conditional.instructions: Is the thing named strongly associated with working only under a specific condition, or becoming much stronger when a condition is met?

power.instructions: How grand and powerful is the thing named, overall?

criteria.lasting: puts an ongoing effect on an area or a unit that keeps working for several turns
criteria.summon: calls a person, creature, or machine to fight or work for the player
criteria.move: moves someone or something to another place

timing.instructions: When would the effect of an orb with this name happen?

criteria.delayed: a few turns later, like a timer, a fuse, or a slow process
criteria.ongoing: again and again every turn for a while
criteria.trigger: only when something specific happens, like a trap or a reaction

range.instructions: How far would the effect of an orb with this name reach?

criteria.line: a line, a short path, or a few neighboring spots
criteria.around: a ring or blast area around one point

side.instructions: Who or what would an orb with this name mostly affect?

criteria.ally: the player and the player's helpers
criteria.land: the terrain, buildings, and resources on the map
criteria.all: everyone and everything in the area, friend and foe alike

persist.instructions: What happens to an orb with this name after it is used?

criteria.used_up: it is a one-time thing that gets used up
criteria.returns: it is a tool or ability that can be used again and again
criteria.stays: it stays on the map after use, like a building, a plant, or a trap
criteria.passive: it is never really 'used': it works just by being carried

pay.instructions: If an orb with this name made money, when would the money arrive?

criteria.none: it has nothing to do with money
criteria.payday: in one lump at the end of a round, on pay day
criteria.saved: it is stored away and grows with interest

verb.instructions: Which effect would the thing named most naturally have when used in this game?

criteria.heal: healing, repairing, restoring, or bringing back to life

criteria.debuff: weakening, slowing, cursing, poisoning, or blinding enemies

criteria.draw: attracting, catching, fishing up, or collecting more things for yourself
criteria.recycle: coming back again, being reborn, echoing, looping, or being used over and over
criteria.trash: throwing away, burning up, erasing, forgetting, or clearing out unwanted things
criteria.peek: foretelling, scouting, spying, or seeing what is hidden or coming next
criteria.tempo: speed, haste, rushing, or doing two things at once
criteria.energy: charging up, fueling, or powering something with energy or mana
criteria.create: making or conjuring a brand-new item, tool, or material

power.instructions: How grand and powerful is the thing named, overall?

criteria.build: places a structure, building, or lasting object on the map
criteria.instant: does one thing right now and is finished, like a spell, a strike, or an action
criteria.lasting: puts an ongoing effect on an area or a unit that keeps working for several turns
criteria.summon: calls a person, creature, or machine to fight or work for the player
criteria.move: moves someone or something to another place

timing.instructions: When would the effect of an orb with this name happen?

criteria.delayed: a few turns later, like a timer, a fuse, or a slow process
criteria.ongoing: again and again every turn for a while
criteria.trigger: only when something specific happens, like a trap or a reaction

range.instructions: How far would the effect of an orb with this name reach?

criteria.line: a line, a short path, or a few neighboring spots
criteria.around: a ring or blast area around one point

side.instructions: Who or what would an orb with this name mostly affect?

criteria.ally: the player and the player's helpers
criteria.land: the terrain, buildings, and resources on the map
criteria.all: everyone and everything in the area, friend and foe alike

persist.instructions: What happens to an orb with this name after it is used?

criteria.used_up: it is a one-time thing that gets used up
criteria.returns: it is a tool or ability that can be used again and again
criteria.stays: it stays on the map after use, like a building, a plant, or a trap
criteria.passive: it is never really 'used': it works just by being carried

pay.instructions: If an orb with this name made money, when would the money arrive?

criteria.none: it has nothing to do with money
criteria.payday: in one lump at the end of a round, on pay day
criteria.saved: it is stored away and grows with interest
